data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to automatically retrieve OTP SMS on Android without SMS permission
data.what_it_does: It listens for incoming SMS, extracts the OTP code, and can also request one‑time consent or manage stored phone numbers via Smart Lock.
use_when: You need to auto‑read OTP codes on Android
You want to avoid requesting SMS permission
You need to store and retrieve user phone numbers
avoid_when: You target iOS or other platforms
You need a cross‑platform SMS solution
strengths: Supports Smart Lock for phone number storage
weaknesses: Requires user to grant one‑time consent for non‑signed messages
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, call async methods; no special permissions needed
